name: python-setup
script:
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame({"group":["Ctrl","Ctrl","IRI","IRI"],"value":[1,2,3,4]})
df.to_csv("qa_intermediate.csv",index=False)
counts=df.groupby("group")["value"].sum()
print(counts)

name: python-plot
script:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots()
counts.plot.bar(ax=ax)
fig.savefig("qa_python.png")
counts.to_csv("qa_counts.csv")
plt.close(fig)
print("done")

name: r-setup
script:
d <- data.frame(group=c("Ctrl","IRI"),n=c(3,7))
sets <- lapply(names(d), function(nm) unique(d[[nm]]))
saveRDS(d,"qa_small.rds")
print(sapply(sets,length))

name: r-plot
script:
d2 <- readRDS("qa_small.rds")
png("qa_r.png",width=600,height=400)
barplot(d2$n,names.arg=d2$group,col=c("steelblue","orange"))
text(c(.7,1.9),d2$n,labels=d2$n,pos=3)
dev.off()
write.csv(d2,"qa_r.csv",row.names=FALSE)

name: python-failure
script:
scratch = 999
raise ValueError("QA intentional failure before recovery")

name: python-recovery
script:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.DataFrame({"x":[1,2,3],"y":[2,4,6]})
fig,ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(df.x, df.y, marker="o")
fig.savefig("qa_recovered.png")
df.to_csv("qa_recovered.csv", index=False)
plt.close(fig)
print("recovered")
